P5.gateway.reason: AgentCore Gateway agentorch-all7-gw is READY but has no target. A target requires a Lambda or OpenAPI backend; creating one needs lambda:CreateFunction, which the anchor-runner IAM user does not hold. Without a target the gateway exposes no tools, so the seam cannot reach a live tool.
P5.gateway.consequence: P5's model calls are live; its gateway hop runs on the in-memory stub. P5 must NOT be described as having exercised the live gateway.
P5.gateway.to_close: Grant lambda:CreateFunction + iam:PassRole for a Lambda execution role, create a minimal Lambda target, then re-run P5.

P3.observability_local_smoke.reason: The anchor-runner IAM user lacks logs:PutLogEvents, so the standalone local smoke test cannot emit. The AgentCore execution role DOES hold it (statement All7ObservabilityWrite), so the deployed agent emits normally.
P3.observability_local_smoke.consequence: P3's observability seam is live in the deployed run and corroborated from CloudWatch, but was not smoke-tested standalone beforehand.
P3.observability_local_smoke.to_close: Grant the anchor-runner user scoped logs write on /agentorch/all7*, or accept deployment-only verification.
